1413939.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Provides extensive illuminated coverage with 100 warm white LEDs, perfect for decorating fences, pergolas, patios, shrubs and garden seating areas
- Choose between static and flashing light functions using the convenient switch located beneath the solar panel, allowing you to create the perfect outdoor ambience
- Built-in light sensors automatically switch the lights on at night and off during daylight hours for effortless, energy-efficient operation
- Charges during the day using sunlight and delivers up to 8 hours of illumination each evening, eliminating the need for mains power or replacement batteries
- Features a 2m cable between the ground stake and first LED, enabling optimal solar panel positioning

## Information
Transform your garden into a warm and inviting outdoor retreat with this set of 10m Solar Powered Garden String Lights. Featuring 100 warm white LEDs, these decorative solar fairy lights are perfect for adding ambient illumination to patios, pergolas, fences, gazebos and garden entertaining spaces. The set features 100 warm white LEDs positioned along a dark green cable, helping the lights blend naturally into garden foliage, hedges and outdoor displays. The 10m illuminated length provides excellent coverage for decorating pathways, seating areas, gazebos and garden borders. Powered by solar energy, the solar panel charges during daylight hours and automatically switches the lights on at dusk. Once fully charged, the lights remain illuminated for up to 8 hours, allowing you to enjoy beautiful outdoor lighting without the need for mains power or batteries. The string lights offer both static and flashing light functions. Simply use the black switch underneath the solar panel to select your preferred lighting effect. The 2m cable length between the ground stake and the first light provides flexible positioning of the solar panel for optimal sunlight exposure while allowing the lights to be placed exactly where needed.
